name: sharpview-fsr-video-upscaler
description: Real-time upscaling of HTML5 videos in Firefox with FSR1 on WebGL2
author: Andrea Cadeddu (https://github.com/skateddu)

scripts.start: web-ext run --source-dir dist/extension --start-url https://www.youtube.com --pref devtools.console.stdout.content=true --pref devtools.console.stdout.chrome=true
scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs --release && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/extension && web-ext build --source-dir dist/extension --overwrite-dest
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:render && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:ui && npm run lint:ext && npm run lint:md
